papers.title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
papers.desc: Prefill and decode reward different approaches to quantization: low-precision arithmetic accelerates prompt processing, while compact weights reduce memory traffic during generation.

papers.title: Tactile-JEPA: Topology-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Distributed Tactile Sensors
papers.desc: Tactile sensing is an essential modality for robots performing contact-rich, dexterous manipulation, particularly under visual occlusion.

papers.title: Enhancing Photogrammetric Digital Surface Models with Pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Conditioning
papers.desc: Large-scale Digital Surface Models (DSMs) can be produced cost-effectively from satellite images via stereo-photogrammetry.

papers.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
papers.desc: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes.

papers.title: IndicBankBench: Evaluating Safety and Reliability of Language Model Assistants in Indian Retail Banking
papers.desc: Banking assistants must use account-specific information to answer requests and, in many cases, take actions through tools.

papers.title: TRACE: Temporal Audit and Condition-aware Evaluation of Streaming Video Understanding
papers.desc: Streaming video understanding requires models to interpret evidence as it arrives, yet current evaluations often report task scores without specifying when evidence becomes valid, how visual history is maintained, or how responses are triggered.

papers.title: LightMIS: Ultra-Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Without a Stage-Wise Decoder
papers.desc: We present LightMIS, a scalable family of ultra-lightweight convolutional networks for 2D binary medical image segmentation without a learned stage-wise decoder.

papers.title: Softmax Reparameterization for Output-Head Quantization
papers.desc: Large vocabularies make output heads a substantial inference cost in small language models.

papers.title: CodeGraph: Open-Taxonomy Knowledge Graph for Source Code with Wikidata Grounding
papers.desc: Public software repositories, like GitHub and Software Heritage Archive, store billions of files, yet extracting their implicit engineering knowledge ---i.e., the algorithms they implement, the paradigms they follow, the patterns they instantiate, and the application domains they serve--- remains challenging, as current tools are constrained to syntactic and token-level analysis.

papers.title: MOPD-Router: Rethinking Teacher Routing in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates specialized capabilities into a single student, but existing practice typically hard-routes each prompt to a domain-matched teacher for the entire rollout.

papers.title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.desc: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability.

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Auditing of Identification Assumptions in Climate-Policy Causal Evaluations
papers.desc: Difference-in-differences (DID) studies are widely used to evaluate climate policy, but assessing the evidence supporting their identification assumptions remains challenging.

papers.title: Depth-adaptive Inference of Looped Language Models via Continuous Depth Batching
papers.desc: A main promise of looped language models is depth-adaptive inference.

papers.title: Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure
papers.desc: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure.

papers.title: BoundInk: Boundary-Aware Online Handwriting Generation
papers.desc: Realistic online handwriting depends not only on individual character shapes, but also on how a writer connects, spaces, and aligns adjacent characters.
